text:
maya: quick sync request — we need to lock the enterprise compliance MVP for audit logs, retention tiers, and BYOK scope. AcmeCorp and FinServX are gating on legal-hold + keys.
alex: can you sketch the immediate tradeoffs?
maya: high level: 1) support per-tenant retention presets + custom window, 2) legal-hold that prevents deletion and marks events immutable, 3) export API for evidence, 4) BYOK handshake (customer-supplied key) but no escrow in MVP. escrow + custodian support as a follow-up.
jordan: security note: immutability must be tamper-evident, include signed manifests and replay-proof audit entries. BYOK handshake needs strong telemetry — handshake success metric and key provenance logs.
priya: from sales calls: customers want recent logs to be queryable (3000d) and a cold archive for >365d that can be exported on demand. Legal-hold speed and simple console controls are purchase blockers.
samira: legal needs e-discovery-friendly exports (CSV + JSONL), chain-of-custody metadata, and a legal-hold release audit trail. Also need accepted formats documented for customer evidence requests.
alex: infra concerns: maintaining a hot index for the last N days (configurable) is expensive. Proposal: hot index up to 90d (queryable), cold object store for older events with export path. This minimizes p95 query latency for hot range.
jordan: if we skip escrow initially, capture the risks: no third-party key escrow means customers may object on enterprise contracts. Offer a documented pilot path with partner custodian. Also define emergency access processes and rotate semantics.
maya: product proposal: MVP-GA = retention presets (30/90/365 + custom), account-level legal-hold toggle, export endpoint (/v1/audit/export?since=&until=&format=), BYOK handshake without escrow. Pilot = escrow with partner custodian for limited customers. GA2 = escrow full offering with SLAs.
priya: customers will push for escrow pricing and contractual language. Pilot offer sounds reasonable to unblock early deals.
alex: SLOs/metrics we must track: export p95 <= 2m for up to 50k events, handshake success >= 99.9%, retention enforcement correctness in CI = 100%, legal-hold release audit accuracy = 100%. Also track storage delta per tenant for UI estimates.
samira: launch gates checklist: 
- export format validated against sample legal ops datasets
- immutability tests (attempted mutation detection)
- cross-region retention policy doc and tests
- privacy/GDPR review of export workflows
- runbook for subpoenas/data-subpoena handling

alex: responsibilities: eng-platform builds export/hot-cold pipeline, eng-sre owns runbook + throttling, eng-security owns BYOK handshake spec, legal owns export validation and retention policy guidance, solutions owns pilot onboarding.
maya: Console UX: retention settings page with quick presets, per-tenant storage impact estimate (tiers: low/med/high), big CTA to place legal-hold (with warning modal), and export flow with sample payload preview. Quick mock: 
Retention presets: 30d | 90d | 365d | Custom
Legal hold: [Place hold] — immutable until released (records an audit entry)
Export: POST /v1/audit/export {since:, until:, format: jsonl|csv} -> job id

priya: cost transparency: show an estimated monthly storage charge and projected export fees when choosing longer retention. That helps procurement discussions.
jordan: ops/runbook items: who triages large export jobs, throttling policy, retry/backoff, escalation for failed key handshakes, and custodial-pilot onboarding checklist.
maya: pilot path outline: 1) GA without escrow to ship faster, 2) partner escrow pilot for up to 3 anchor customers, 3) iterate to GA2 with contractual SLAs once pilot learnings captured.
ops-bot: Calendar invite created: "Audit tiers & BYOK launch sync" Fri 10am — maya, alex, jordan, priya, samira invited.
priya: I'll assemble sample data from AcmeCorp and FinServX for export format validation.
alex: eng to prototype hot/cold index approach (ETA 3w).
jordan: security to draft BYOK handshake spec + rotation/emergency access policy (ETA 2w).
samira: legal to publish immutability test cases and acceptable export schema (ETA 1w).
maya: product to produce Console mocks and storage estimate UX (ETA 2w).
priya: we should also prepare a short customer-facing FAQ for the no-escrow MVP and pilot option.
maya: agreed. I'll upload initial assets to https://redwood.internal/docs/compliance/audit-tiering-playbook and follow up after prototypes. :thumbsup:
